name: Pipewren
summary: A CRM workspace that ranks leads by priority and explains every score in plain English
about: A sales workspace that lists leads in order of priority and shows each lead's full record next to a breakdown of why it ranks where it does. Live signals such as pricing visits and replies change scores while you watch, rows slide to their new rank, and a scoring model with weight sliders lets you tune the ranking. Good for a sales team or anyone building a sales tool.
how: Use the thin rail on the left (a bottom bar on phones) to switch between the seven pages.
On Priority queue, pick a lead or use the up and down arrow keys; the record and the Why this rank panel follow your choice.
Watch live signals arrive: scores change and rows slide to their new rank with up and down markers. Pause or resume the signals at any time.
Log a call, send an email, change the status, snooze or edit a lead from its record, or open the full record with tabs and notes.
On Scoring model, drag the weight sliders to preview the new ranking, then save the model.
Enrol leads in Sequences and tick off each step; Reports checks that higher scores qualify more often.
Settings changes the hot and warm thresholds, automation switches and theme, and can reset the demo data.
